Layers.BatchScopeHint.zh: 批操作作用于完整选择；锁定项按操作规则跳过。
Layers.BatchScopeHint.en: Batch commands use the entire selection; locked items are skipped where required.

Layers.MoveSourceChanged.zh: 来源选择或编辑状态已改变。请取消后重新打开移动窗口。
Layers.MoveSourceChanged.en: The source selection or editing state changed. Cancel and reopen Move to.

Layers.MoveNothingEligible.zh: 当前选择已没有可移动的对象。
Layers.MoveNothingEligible.en: No selected objects can be moved now.

Layers.MoveTargetUnavailable.zh: 原目标已不存在或不在搜索结果中，请重新选择。
Layers.MoveTargetUnavailable.en: The previous destination is missing or outside these search results. Choose another destination.

Canvas.RectificationSummary.zh: 预览扭正比例；应用会调整画布逻辑尺寸，可撤销。
Canvas.RectificationSummary.en: Preview the proportions. Applying changes the logical canvas size and can be undone.

Canvas.MarkGridIssueHint.zh: 仅标记受影响区域，不改变选择、层级或画布视图。若对象在视野外，请取消校准后定位检查。可先调整取样或格数；仍失败时，取消后处理这些对象。
Canvas.MarkGridIssueHint.en: Marks the affected area without changing selection, scope or the canvas view. If it is off-screen, cancel calibration to locate it. Adjust the sample or counts first; if needed, cancel and inspect these objects.
